note: Addresses insight I-012 (learners understand textbook audio but go deaf in real conversation). Two changes: (1) the speed button now cycles through three speeds - Slow 0.7x, Normal 1.0x, Real 1.3x - so tapping three times compares the same line at three speeds and trains the ear toward real-life tempo; (2) every scene line now has a 'Real speech' section with two authentic spoken variants (with pinyin, a note on when to use it, and a casual / polite / formal / slang label) because learners asked for real-life Chinese, not book Chinese.
